transcript: Before the first count of days God brought heaven and earth into being Earth stood bare unfinished Blackness covered the deep Across the water moved the spirit of God Then God called, light come forth Brightness answered He looked on the light good He cut a clear line between it and darkness Day was the night he gave the light Night the night he gave the dark dust On the first day God spoke from a man amid the waters, let water pass from water. His word took hold, he raised that mighty span, flood beneath it, flood above it, he called the former in heaven. He looked on it good, thus dawn the second day. Hey, waters below heaven run to one place Let dry ground show The waters gathered land came clear He named the dry ground earth That gathered water, seas, he looked on them Good, good, good, good, good, good Grounds end up seed-bearing grass in kind and likeness Trees bear fruit with seed within each true to its kind His words are cold Grease urge from the soil, grass with seed in its kind and likeness Fruit wrapped around its seed, tree by tree, kind by kind He looked on it On it Good head Dusk dawn, the third day Lights across heaven's firmament Divide day from night Marks on seasons, days and years From that height shine on the earth His Word took home Two great lights He fashioned The greater took command The day, the lesser took command In the night he made the stars as well He set them in heaven's span To send their light across the earth To rule night and day To keep the bright apart from dark He looked on them Good Dusked on the fourth day Water swarmed with living reptiles Winged creatures fly above the earth Across heaven's firmament His Word took hold God made the great whales Every living water reptile by kind And every winged creature by kind He looked on them good His blessing rang out Increase, multiply Fill the seas Let the winged multiply on earth Dust on the fifth day Ever bring out living kinds Four-footed beasts calling reptiles wild beasts Each after its kind His word took hold He fashioned wild beasts Cattle and the reptiles of the ground Each after its kind He looked on them good, then God said, Let us make humankind, in our image, in our likeness, Let the wing it multiply on earth, God's best word took hold. He fashioned world, beasts, cattle, and the reptiles of the ground, Each after sky. We looked on them, good Then God said, let us make humankind In our image, in our likeness Let them rule the fish, the birds The cattle, all the earth and all that crows Hey, dust on the fish, yeah Good, good, good
